sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id,SUM(re.points) points FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id HAVING SUM(re.points)>0), low AS (SELECT * FROM totals t WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(points) FROM totals x WHERE x.year=t.year)) SELECT l.year,d.forename,d.surname,c.name,l.points FROM low l JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE constructor_id IN (15,17,18,21) ORDER BY year,constructor_id
